seoTitle: When Is Black Friday 2026 UK? Dates for Every Retailer
title: When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK? Dates for Amazon, Argos, Currys, Boots and more
description: Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Which UK retailers' sales have started, and when the rest begin.
intro:
**Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, and Cyber Monday is on Monday 30 November.** Black Friday is **five days away**, on Friday. Amazon's Black Friday Week **started on 19 November** and runs to 30 November, with deals on its own devices live since 16 November. John Lewis's main event started on 17 November. Many other UK retailers have already started: Currys, Boots and AO went live on 28 October, Argos on 30 October and Very on 2 November.

Amazon's Black Friday Week prices published on 21 November include the Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99 (its lowest-ever price, per TechRadar), the Kindle (2026) at a record-low £119.99, the Dyson V8 at £199.99 and the Ninja Dual Zone air fryer at £119.99. New this weekend: the AirPods Pro 3 dropped to £165 at Amazon on Sunday afternoon (was £219), the Sonos Ace headphones are £199 at Amazon (was £349), the Dyson Supersonic hair dryer is £199 (£100 off) and the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer is £99. Our [deals of the day](/deals/2026-11-22-sunday-deals/) has more. PS5 buyers: the GTA VI bundles are the main console deals so far (see our [PS5 Black Friday guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/)). For the best offers live right now, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/), checked three times a day. This page tracks each retailer's dates and is updated as they announce. Last checked: 22 November 2026, 5:53pm.
body:
## Black Friday 2026 UK: the key dates

- **Black Friday:** Friday 27 November 2026
- **Cyber Monday:** Monday 30 November 2026
- **Amazon Black Friday Week (confirmed):** 19 to 30 November, with Amazon device deals from 16 November
- **Earliest retailer sales:** already live at Currys, Boots and AO (from 28 October) Argos (from 30 October) and Very (from 2 November)

## Which Black Friday 2026 sales have started?

**Already live (confirmed):**

- **Currys:** live since **28 October**, running to **1 December**. Its price promise covers Black Friday products bought between 28 October and 24 November: if Currys cuts the price before 1 December, it refunds the difference.
- **Boots:** live since **28 October**, with over 3,000 products. Boots also runs weekly Star Gifts alongside it.
- **AO:** live since **28 October**, running to **1 December**.
- **Argos:** live from **30 October to 1 December**. Badged items carry a price guarantee until Christmas Day. See our [Argos Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/).
- **B&Q:** live from **30 October to 30 November**.
- **Very:** runs from **Monday 2 November to Friday 4 December**, according to its Black Friday page. See our [Very Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/very-black-friday-2026/).
- **John Lewis:** its Black Friday event **started on Tuesday 17 November** and runs to Cyber Monday, 30 November. Some tech and beauty offers, including 25% off selected fragrance, skincare and makeup, are already live (checked 16 November). It matches prices at 25 big-name rivals.
- **Superdrug:** early online fragrance offers are on now. The full sale runs from **Wednesday 4 November to Tuesday 1 December**.
- **Smyths Toys:** Black Friday toy deals are live on its site (checked 9 November), alongside £5 off every £50 on selected LEGO. Argos's toy offers are live too; see our [Christmas toy deals spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-toy-deals-2026/).
- **Decathlon and Oodie:** both opened their Black Friday sales to everyone on 2 November.
- **Amazon:** Black Friday Week runs from **Thursday 19 November to Cyber Monday, 30 November**, Amazon confirmed on 10 November. Deals on Kindle, Echo, Fire TV, Ring and Blink devices have been live since **16 November**, and early deals on other brands such as Dyson and Sonos are already showing (18 November). Prime members get extra 'Epic Prime Deals', so if you're not a member, [start a Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) just before you shop. The live deals are on [Amazon's Black Friday page](https://www.amazon.co.uk/blackfriday). See our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) and our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) on timing a trial.
- **Tesco:** its Black Friday page lists offer days on 10, 17, 24, 27 and 30 November.
- **Halfords:** its sale is reported to run until **1 December**.

- **Debenhams:** its Black Friday page (checked 16 November) shows 'up to 80% off', running to **6 December**.
- **Dunelm:** up to 50% off from **9 to 30 November**.
- **M&S:** doesn't officially do Black Friday, but started an online 'up to 50% off' sale on **12 November**.
- **Lidl:** Black Friday offers in store from **12 November**, with tech and kitchen drops from **Thursday 19 November**.

**Not announced yet (as of 16 November):**

- **Ninja and Shark:** their shared Black Friday page still only offers a sign-up (checked 11 November), though some deal sites report early offers on selected products. Amazon and Argos usually match their prices once they start.
- **Next:** has skipped Black Friday since 2020 and hasn't said otherwise this year; its big sale is on Boxing Day. See our [Boxing Day sales guide](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/).
- **Aldi:** no official dates yet.

Dyson's own Black Friday sale is now live, with V15 and Airwrap prices cut; see our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Do the best deals come early or on the day?

For most products, the lowest prices land in the **last week before Black Friday**, when Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on 19 November and the other big retailers match it. Early November deals are often genuine, but they're rarely the lowest prices of the season. Two exceptions: **advent calendars** and **toys** sell out, so buy them early.

Brand by brand, our guides show which prices to wait for: [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/), [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) and more on our [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).

### What date is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November 2026. It's always the Friday after the American Thanksgiving holiday.

### When is Cyber Monday 2026?

Monday 30 November 2026. Many Black Friday deals carry on until then, and some retailers add extra online offers.

### When do Amazon Black Friday deals start in 2026?

Thursday 19 November. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to Cyber Monday, 30 November, and deals on its own devices started on 16 November.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday?

For tech, vacuums, kitchen gadgets and Amazon devices, usually yes. For things that sell out, like advent calendars, popular toys and limited gift sets, buy when you see a good price.

### Are Black Friday deals real?

Some are, and many aren't. Consumer group Which? has repeatedly found that most Black Friday 'deals' were the same price or cheaper at other times. Our [Black Friday guide](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) explains how to check a price in 30 seconds.
